validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real, not a phantom/GEM-only entity. Meleiha (مليحة) is a well-documented Eni-operated (76%) / Lukoil (24%) oil-and-gas field in the Western Desert ~130 km north of Siwa Oasis, discovered 2018, first production 2019, official production from April 2022 (attaqa.net, a field-history report published 2025-07-28, read in full via direct fetch of the raw HTML, not just the current_ref's automated substring check). CLASSIFICATION: 'gas pipeline' / Fuel=Gas / PipelineType=transmission is correct and matches how both sources describe it -- attaqa.net explicitly distinguishes this project from a SEPARATE oil pipeline built in Phase 1 (also within Meleiha, $31M, described earlier in the same article), so this is not an oil line misfiled as gas. The 130 km/20-inch line is reported alongside but distinct from a 122 km/19-well 'network' (gathering flowlines feeding the processing station) -- the 130 km line's greater length/diameter and its role carrying processed gas toward the national grid tie-in is consistent with a transmission classification rather than a gathering line. DUPLICATE: checked against the full 40-row Egypt-gas roster provided -- no other row references Meleiha, this field/project, or an overlapping corridor; no duplicate concern. FUELSOURCE: 'Meleiha Gas & Oil Field' matches the source's own framing ('حقل مليحة للنفط والغاز' = 'Meleiha oil and gas field'). LOCATION: StartState/Province and EndState/Province both 'Western Desert', Egypt -- correct; the pipeline runs entirely within the Meleiha concession in the Western Desert (from the field's early-production/processing facility toward the grid connection), and neither source gives a more specific start/end place name, so leaving both endpoints at the field/province level rather than inventing a city name is the right call, not a gap. SPEC (length/diameter): independently corroborated at TWO separate outlets, 16 months apart -- youm7.com (2024-03-05, reporting the Petrojet-Schlumberger/SLB EPC contract signing for the Phase 2 early-production-facilities station) and attaqa.net (2025-07-28, a later field-history piece) both give the identical figure verbatim: 'تصميم وتوريد وتنفيذ واختبار خط غاز بقطر 20 بوصة وبطول 130 كيلومتراً' ('design, supply, execution and testing of a 20-inch, 130 km gas line'). Both URLs re-verified live via url_verifier with tokens '130' and '20' present. Not a single wire story reprinted -- two different outlets, two different article angles (contract-signing news vs. field retrospective), 16 months apart, both attributable ultimately to the same EGPC/Petrojet contract scope but independently reported.

validity.researcher_notes: The sheet's Status='construction' is a reasonable but not tightly confirmed reading. youm7.com (2024-03-05) reports only that Petrojet SIGNED the EPC contract with Schlumberger/SLB for the Phase 2 early-production-facilities station (design+supply+execution+testing) -- a contract award, not a construction-in-progress confirmation. attaqa.net (2025-07-28), read in full via direct HTML fetch (the current_ref's automated check correctly flagged that the literal token 'construction' isn't findable -- there is no English word to match against Arabic text, and I did not rely on that automated substring check), frames the state as 'تستعد الدولة لبدء أعمال المرحلة الثانية' ('the state is preparing to BEGIN Phase 2 works') as of that July 2025 publication -- language that reads as pre-construction/still-mobilizing rather than confirmed active construction, even though the EPC contract itself (which covers design through execution/testing) had already been signed over a year earlier. I could not locate a 2026 source updating the status further -- this session's WebSearch quota was already exhausted (200/200, shared across this batch's row audits) before I reached P8070, and a DuckDuckGo/Bing fallback via WebFetch returned no usable results (DuckDuckGo served its JS shell; Bing returned unrelated cached results for an unrelated query). Given (a) the EPC contract was signed by March 2024, (b) EPC contracts of this type typically move into physical construction within 1-2 years, and (c) GEM's own row was only added/updated 2026-08-12 (recent), 'construction' is a defensible read of the project's current phase, but it should be read as inferred from timeline/contract-scope reasoning rather than as a source explicitly stating pipe is being laid today.

summary: P8070 (Meleiha Gas Pipeline) confirmed real and correctly classified -- length (130 km) and diameter (20 in) independently corroborated by two separate outlets 16 months apart (youm7.com 2024-03-05, attaqa.net 2025-07-28), no duplicate found against the 40-row roster, Fuel/FuelSource/Location all check out; one caveat flagged (not a hard concern) on Status='construction', which is plausible from contract-award timing but not explicitly confirmed as physically underway by either available source.
